subject: general
question: _________________ recommend(s) 20 mm wide margins for sheet sizes AO and A1 in engineering drawings.
solution:
The correct answer is __Borders and frames: SP: 46 (2003).__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Borders and frames: SP: 46 (2003)__ is a standard for engineering drawings.
 
• It recommends 20 mm wide margins for sheet sizes AO and A1.
 
• SP: 46 (2003) provides guidelines for technical drawings to ensure uniformity and accuracy.
 
• Margins are essential for maintaining clarity and accessibility in professional drawings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Custom Grids:**

 
 
• Custom grids are used for layout alignment in drawings but do not specify margin width.
 
 
 
• **Geographic Coordinate Systems:**
 
 
• These systems are used for mapping and navigation, unrelated to engineering drawing margins.
 
 
 
• **Grid Reference System:**
 
 
• Grid reference systems help locate points on maps or plans but do not deal with margin recommendations.
